certificate_exception_added:
    type: event
    description: >
      Tracks each time a TLS certificate exception is created, what the problem
      with the certificate is, and what code is using the certificate.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1983982
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1983982#c4
    data_sensitivity:
      - interaction
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never
    extra_keys:
      error_category:
        description: >
          The reported certificate error that required an exception, e.g.
          MOZILLA_PKIX_ERROR_SELF_SIGNED_CERT.
          From nsITransportSecurityInfo.errorCodeString.
        type: string
      protocol:
        description: >
          The protocol trying to use the certificate, e.g. "imap" or "caldav".
        type: string
      port:
        description: The network port in use.
        type: string
      ui:
        description: Identifies the code handling the certificate exception.
        type: string
